headline: Banco do Brasil App Experiences Technical Instability
summary: Banco do Brasil reported technical instability on its mobile application, stating that digital channels were being normalized and that card operations were unaffected.
why: Banco do Brasil is one of the largest financial institutions in Latin America, and service disruptions on digital platforms affect customer transactions and operational compliance.

impacts.name: Banco do Brasil
impacts.why: App outages can cause temporary customer dissatisfaction and operational friction.
